text:
Maya R: spotted ~0.9% of daily previewed usage attributed to fallback route despite clients sending route tags. customers filed tickets.
Tom H: probable places: proxy header pass, or enrich stage losing tag. logs?
Maya R: logs show mobile SDKs sometimes omit X-Client-Route; also proxy cache layer rewriting some headers.
Oliver V: propose new header X-RW-Metering: rid=route:eu-2a-07;plan=ent;v=1 and optional X-RW-Metering-Sig for HMAC. backend will prefer signed hint.
Priya K: telemetry fields required: metering_hint_seen, metering_hint_signed, metering_hint_trusted, metering_hint_applied. console needs filter to compare hinted vs resolved series.
Tom H: rollout suggestion:
- phase 0 (observe) 1% traffic: parse header, emit telemetry only.
- phase 1 (trusted apply) 10%: honor signed hints for enterprise tenants; show preview diffs and alert if delta > 1% value.
- phase 2 (full) allow unsigned after TTL and admin opt-in; flagged as untrusted.
Finance Ops: create nightly recon job to flag tenant diffs > $250/day during rollout. embargoed comms to enterprise customers required before phase 1.
Console Bot: UI changes: banner on preview when mixed attribution present and toggles to include/exclude hinted attribution; preview API param include_hints=true/false.
Tom H: infra work: small go parser lib, proxy passthrough (envoy filter), enrich preference change, preview flag, console overlay. CI lint rule to reject malformed headers at proxy.
metering-bot: [automated] sample: ts=7765433000 tenant=starlabs metering_hint_seen=true metering_hint_signed=false metering_hint_applied=false resolver=default
Maya R: action owners: Tom (proxy+parser+tests), Oliver (enrich+telemetry), Maya (runbook+canary), Console Bot (UI), Finance Ops (recon+comms).
Tom H: will open PRs and a 7-day canary runbook next week. Security signoff needed for HMAC key handling prior to phase 1.
Maya R: thanks all. post follow-ups here and I'll track action items.
